title: NIMHANS Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Project Research Scientist I Posts
description: The National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) has released a notification to fill the vacancies for various Project Research Scientist I Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in M.Pharm and M.Sc can apply for the NIMHANS Jobs 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
